cmd.ctx.ceiling.clean_outline.desc: Removes narrow spikes where the ceiling outline turns back on itself. Shows a preview first; one undo step.
cmd.ctx.shaft.clean_outline.desc: Removes narrow spikes where the shaft outline turns back on itself. Shows a preview first; one undo step.
outline_cleanup.intro_ceiling: The outline of this ceiling turns back on itself in narrow spikes: {n}. Clean-up removes them; everything else stays as it is.
outline_cleanup.intro_shaft: The outline of this shaft turns back on itself in narrow spikes: {n}. Clean-up removes them; everything else stays as it is.
outline_cleanup.none_ceiling: The outline of this ceiling has no spikes
outline_cleanup.none_shaft: The outline of this shaft has no spikes
outline_cleanup.need_host: Select a floor, ceiling or shaft
